evidence_locator: Scott HW, History of Surgery at Vanderbilt University (VUMC, 1996); Alan Mason Chesney Medical Archives (JHM) Blalock biography; VUMC Dept of Thoracic Surgery Blalock profile
notes: route: 01_halsted_core [V15] TRUE incoming lineage for Blalock, replacing the retired false JHH-as-Halsted edge. Blalock was DENIED the Halsted residency (average record); after a Hopkins urology internship + a non-renewed assistant residency, he completed formative training under Barney Brooks (Vanderbilt's first Professor/Chief of Surgery) from Sept 1925, becoming Vanderbilt's first chief resident. Brooks himself was a Halsted pupil, so this correctly seats Blalock as Halsted's GRAND-pupil (Halsted->Brooks->Blalock), not a direct Halstedian.

route: 02_general_surgery_spread [V15] Cameron split (part 1 of 2). Cameron (MD Hopkins 1962) began general/thoracic training at Hopkins under Blalock, surgeon-in-chief 1941-1964. Javed & Weiss (Ann Surg 2018, PMID 29189382) document his complete Hopkins training; the Blalock-era attribution (1962-64) is by documented chief tenure. Companion edge: George Zuidema->Cameron (1964-1971).

route: 08_subspecialties [V15] Thompson split (part 1 of 2). Thompson trained at Michigan 1956-1964; Frederick Coller chaired to his 1958 retirement. Coller-era attribution (1956-58) by documented chair tenure. Companion edge: C. Gardner Child III->Thompson (1959-1964, Child chair from 1959).
